_comment: Lane preflight policy (DATA, not code). The hotfile set is MEASURED, never authored from intuition: across 23 concurrent reorg PRs the run touched 1937 distinct paths, of which only 21 collided — but those 21 reached 20 of the 23 PRs, so 21 of 23 conflicted. Every PR body asserted path-disjointness and every assertion was true of what the PR MOVED and false of what it RETARGETED. The eight paths below are that measured collision core: they are the shared registries, policy documents and gate fixtures that any lane touching the build graph, the capability set, or a facade gate ends up retargeting. A lane declaring one of them is claiming a mutex the run cannot grant in parallel, so it belongs in a serialized owner cell rather than in the fan-out. The three min_expected_* floors are the anti-vacuity backstop, and min_expected_hotfiles is the one that matters most: an empty hotfile list makes every hotfile intersection trivially empty, so the gate would pass every lane while checking nothing — the same silent-perfect-coverage failure the corpus-index-coverage ratchet guards with min_expected_yaml_packages. ALL repo-specifics are DATA; another repo adopts this preflight by repointing these values.

measured._comment: The run this policy is frozen against. Recorded so a later reader can tell whether the hotfile set moved or the run did.

product_contract.fail_closed: Every finding blocks. Unlike a debt ratchet this gate has no legitimate backlog: each condition is a lane that will silently produce nothing or silently conflict, so there is no advisory tier.
product_contract.computed_not_asserted: Path disjointness is COMPUTED from the declared sets by intersection, including directory containment. Author-asserted disjointness is never an input. 23 of 23 assertions were sincere and 21 of 23 were wrong.
product_contract.pure_kernel: The evaluator does no I/O, no clock, no rand and no subprocess. The CALLER runs git rev-parse / git cat-file -e / git check-ignore and passes the answers in as data, which keeps the measurement independent of the artifact under test.
product_contract.anti_vacuity: min_expected_lanes, min_expected_declared_paths and min_expected_hotfiles fail the gate closed when the run or the policy collapses. Zero lanes intersect in zero paths, which is indistinguishable from perfect disjointness — that is exactly how the .omc/specs/ lane earned a clean verdict.
product_contract.known_limitations: Declared paths are compared as repo-relative strings with directory containment. Symlinks, case-insensitive filesystems, and renames declared only at the destination are not resolved here; the caller must normalize those before declaring.

purpose: Make the OWN-phase commit rule and 'hotfiles never in owner cells' EXECUTABLE, so a lane cannot report success for work that was never committed, was never git-visible, or was never actually disjoint.
